# pbs_s3_endpoint (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox Backup Server S3 client configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pbs_s3_endpoint" "example" {
  id = "my-s3-endpoint"
  
  # S3 configuration
  access_key = "your-access-key"
  secret_key = "your-secret-key"
  endpoint   = "s3.amazonaws.com"  # S3 service endpoint (hostname only, no https://)
  region     = "us-west-2"
  
  # Optional settings
  fingerprint = ""  # SSL certificate fingerprint if needed
  port        = 443
  path_style  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) Access key for S3 object store.
- `endpoint` (String) Endpoint to access S3 object store.
- `id` (String) ID to uniquely identify S3 client config (3-32 chars, alphanumeric with dots, dashes, underscores).
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 secret key.

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) X509 certificate fingerprint (sha256).
- `path_style` (Boolean) Use path style bucket addressing over vhost style.
- `port` (Number) Port to access S3 object store.
- `provider_quirks` (Set of String) S3 provider-specific quirks. Use `['skip-if-none-match-header']` for Backblaze B2 compatibility to handle unsupported S3 headers.
- `region` (String) Region to access S3 object store (3-32 chars, lowercase alphanumeric with dashes/underscores).
